Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Solar Snapshot: Custom Values

Custom values in the solar snapshot are tailored to optimize marketing strategies, enhance customer engagement, and streamline service delivery for your solar business. These values empower you to effectively manage campaigns, gather testimonials, schedule appointments, and maintain your online reputation.

52 Week Nurture Campaign Offer Page

This value represents the landing page or offer page associated with your 52-week nurture campaign. It showcases the benefits of your solar services and encourages potential clients to engage with your campaign.

Customer Referral Campaign Offer

The customer referral campaign offer specifies the incentive or reward offered to existing customers for referring new clients to your solar business. It incentivizes word-of-mouth marketing and promotes customer loyalty.

Customer Testimonials Page Link

This link directs clients to a dedicated page featuring testimonials from satisfied customers. Testimonials serve as social proof of your solar services' quality and reliability, building trust and credibility among potential clients.

DR Campaign Offer

The DR campaign offer is a customizable value associated with specific marketing campaigns aimed at generating direct responses from potential clients. It may include special promotions, discounts, or incentives to encourage immediate action.

Free Quote Calendar Link

The free quote calendar link provides access to your calendar for scheduling free quotes or consultations for solar services. It streamlines the process of booking appointments and facilitates lead generation for your solar business.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management)

This link directs clients to leave continuous reviews for your solar business on platforms like Google. It helps build and maintain a positive online reputation, which is crucial for attracting new clients and retaining existing ones.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign)

Similar to continuous reputation management, this link is associated with a specific review campaign aimed at prompting clients to leave reviews for your solar business. It contributes to your online credibility and visibility, enhancing your reputation in the industry.

Service

This value specifies the type of solar service offered by your business, whether it's solar panel installation, maintenance, repair, or consultation. It ensures clarity and consistency in communication with potential clients.

Service Area

The service area defines the geographical region where your solar services are available. It helps potential clients determine if your services are accessible to them and ensures accurate communication regarding service availability.

Service Calendar Link

The service calendar link provides access to your calendar for scheduling solar services appointments. It simplifies the process of booking appointments and ensures efficient time management for both you and your clients.

These custom values empower you to tailor your marketing efforts, manage appointments effectively, and maintain a positive online reputation for your solar business, ultimately driving success and growth in the solar industry.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main Solar Leads Pipeline: The main solar leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your solar -related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your solar business.

3. Calendars

Solar Snapshot: Calendars

Calendars play a crucial role in managing appointments, scheduling services, and facilitating communication with clients in your solar business. In our solar snapshot, we offer two specialized calendars designed to streamline scheduling processes and enhance customer experience.

Service Calendar

The Service Calendar is a dedicated tool for scheduling and managing solar service appointments. It allows clients to book appointments for solar panel installation, maintenance, repairs, or consultations conveniently. Key features include:

Appointment Scheduling: Enables clients to view available time slots and schedule service appointments based on their preferences and availability.

Service Details: Provides information on the types of solar services offered and allows clients to select the appropriate service category for their appointment.

Confirmation and Reminders: Sends automated confirmation and reminder notifications to clients to minimize no-shows and ensure smooth service delivery.

Benefits:

Enhanced Customer Experience: Provides a user-friendly interface for clients to schedule appointments, improving accessibility and satisfaction.

Book A Free Quote Calendar

The Book A Free Quote Calendar allows potential clients to schedule free quotes or consultations for solar services. It simplifies the process of requesting quotes and facilitates lead generation for your solar business. Key features include:

Quote Request Form: Enables potential clients to submit their contact information and details about their solar project requirements.

Availability Check: Provides real-time availability for scheduling free quotes or consultations, ensuring prompt response to client inquiries.

Confirmation and Reminders: Sends automated confirmation and reminder notifications to clients to confirm their scheduled appointments and minimize missed opportunities.

Benefits:

Lead Generation: Facilitates lead generation by capturing contact information and project details from potential clients interested in solar services, expanding your client base.

Streamlined Booking Process: Simplifies the process of scheduling free quotes or consultations, improving accessibility and convenience for potential clients.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the solar snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the solar free quote Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

6. Funnels

Solar Snapshot: Funnels

Funnels are strategic marketing frameworks designed to guide potential clients through a series of steps, ultimately leading them to take a specific action, such as scheduling a consultation or claiming an offer. In our solar snapshot, we offer four specialized funnels tailored to attract, engage, and convert leads effectively.

Get Your Solar Savings Estimate! Funnel

The Get Your Solar Savings Estimate! Funnel empowers potential clients to obtain an estimate of potential savings through solar energy solutions. This three-step funnel includes a survey page, booking page, and thank-you page. Key features include:

Survey Page: Collects information from potential clients about their energy usage, property details, and preferences to generate a customized savings estimate.

Booking Page: Guides clients through the process of scheduling a consultation or appointment to discuss their savings estimate further.

Thank-You Page: Expresses appreciation to clients for their interest and confirms the successful submission of their information.

Benefits:

Personalized Savings Estimate: Provides potential clients with a customized estimate of potential savings through solar energy solutions, increasing engagement and interest.

Streamlined Appointment Booking: Simplifies the process of scheduling consultations or appointments after obtaining a savings estimate, improving accessibility and convenience for potential clients.

Solar $500 Voucher Funnel

The Solar $500 Voucher Funnel offers potential clients a $500 voucher to incentivize them to engage with your solar business. This two-step funnel includes an opt-in page and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Opt-In Page: Encourages potential clients to provide their contact information in exchange for a $500 voucher towards solar services.

Thank-You Page: Delivers the $500 voucher and expresses appreciation to clients for their interest in solar energy solutions.

Benefits:

Conversion Incentive: Provides a compelling offer to motivate potential clients to engage with your solar business, driving conversions and lead generation.

Lead Capture: Captures contact information from potential clients interested in solar services, expanding your client base and fostering engagement.

Solar 60 Sec Survey Funnel

The Solar 60 Sec Survey Funnel engages potential clients with a quick survey about their solar energy preferences and needs. This two-step funnel includes a survey page and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Survey Page: Presents a brief survey with questions about potential clients' energy usage, interest in solar solutions, and preferences.

Thank-You Page: Thanks clients for completing the survey and provides further information or instructions as needed.

Benefits:

Engagement and Insights: Engages potential clients with a quick and interactive survey, gathering valuable insights into their preferences and needs for solar energy solutions.

Lead Generation: Captures contact information from potential clients who complete the survey, expanding your client base and fostering engagement.

Solar VSL (Video Sales Letter) Funnel

The Solar VSL Funnel utilizes video content to engage potential clients and highlight the benefits of solar energy solutions. This three-step funnel includes a video page, booking page, and thank-you page. Key features include:

Video Page: Presents engaging video content showcasing the benefits of solar energy solutions and offers, such as potential savings and environmental benefits.

Booking Page: Guides clients through the process of scheduling consultations or appointments after watching the video.

Thank-You Page: Confirms the successful scheduling of the appointment and provides further details or instructions.

Offer: Home Owners, Here's how you can SAVE $1000 - $3000 Every Single year with NO upfront Cost.

Benefits:

Engaging Content: Captivates potential clients with compelling video content, increasing interest and engagement with solar energy solutions.

Conversion Optimization: Guides potential clients through a structured series of steps, increasing the likelihood of conversion and lead generation.

Benefits of Solar Funnels

Guided Conversion Process: Directs potential clients through a structured series of steps, increasing the likelihood of conversion and lead generation.

Incentivized Action: Provides compelling offers or incentives to motivate potential clients to engage with your solar business, driving conversions and engagement.

Engagement and Insights: Engages potential clients with interactive content such as surveys or video presentations, gathering valuable insights into their preferences and needs.

Lead Generation: Captures contact information from potential clients interested in solar energy solutions, expanding your client base and fostering engagement.

With our specialized funnels, you can attract, engage, and convert leads effectively, driving growth and success for your solar business in the renewable energy industry.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

7. 52 Week Nurture Campaigns

In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive 52-week email and text solar nurture campaigns designed to cultivate relationships with your leads and keep your solar business top-of-mind. Here's what you can expect:

52-Week Email Nurture Campaign: This campaign consists of a series of weekly emails delivered to your solar leads over the course of a year. Each email contains valuable tips, industry insights, and exclusive offers tailored to their needs and interests. The goal of this campaign is to keep your solar business front and center in the minds of your leads while providing them with ongoing value and engagement.

52-Week Text Nurture Campaign: Similarly, the 52-week text nurture campaign delivers weekly text messages to your solar leads, keeping them informed and engaged with your solar business. These texts may include quick tips, special promotions, or reminders about upcoming events or services. The goal is to maintain regular communication with your leads through a convenient and accessible channel, fostering a sense of connection and trust.

Increased Engagement: Regular communication through emails and text messages keeps your solar business top-of-mind and encourages ongoing interaction with your leads, increasing engagement and retention rates.

Customizable Content: You have the flexibility to customize the content of both the emails and text messages to align with your branding, messaging, and marketing objectives. Whether it's sharing educational content, promoting special offers, or inviting leads to events, you can tailor the campaigns to suit your unique business needs.

With our 52-week email and text solar nurture campaigns, you can stay connected with your leads, provide them with valuable insights and offers, and nurture them towards conversion over the long term.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the solar. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the solar, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the solar, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the solar, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your solar business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your solar business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your solar business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
